## In progress (MVP)

- `6.4.1` Lookup docid by external id newest→oldest segment (IdMap FST) (M6)
- `6.4.2` Tombstone sidecar format + versioning (SPEC §8.3, ADR); the writer builds each version as a superset of the previous one, checked before commit (the manifest only sees counts, SPEC §8.7.2) (M6)
- `6.4.3` Delete-by-id and upsert through commit; visibility rules (read-your-writes). Until then a flush keeps only the memtable's live documents, so a delete or upsert of an id in an older segment is lost at the flush (ADR-0029, found in 6.3) (M6)
- `6.4.4` [T] differential tests vs. reference model for random put/delete/commit sequences (M6)

## Ready next (first 15 MVP todo leaves whose milestone deps are done)

- `6.1.5` `SearchView` parity for queries: term enumeration (prefix, range, automaton) and column access over segments and the memtable, for 7.1 `Prefix`/`Fuzzy` and 7.4.5 filters (found in 6.1.2) (M6)
- `6.1.6` Undo a failed `put` without rehashing the term arenas: `Arena::truncate` rebuilds the whole table under the write lock, O(terms) per rejected document (found in the 6.1 review) (M6)
- `6.3.10` Schema change and drop through commit (SPEC §8.2.1, §8.7.2): both flush every memtable first, so `wal_start` reaches the end of the log and no record of an earlier schema (or of the dropped collection) is replayed; reopen the collection's segments with the evolved schema. Test: a non-`strict` put with extra fields, then `strict`, then a crash and reopen (found in 6.3.9) (M6)
- `6.3.11` Flush without re-indexing: build the segment from the memtable's postings instead of analyzing every document again (ADR-0029, found in 6.3.1); bench the flush before and after (M6)
- `6.5.1` Merge policy (tiered) as pure function: segments → merge plans; [T] table tests (M6)
- `6.5.2.1` Merge term dictionaries and postings (k-way) (M6)
- `6.5.2.2` Merge columns, norms, doc store, id map, blob refs (M6)
- `6.5.2.3` Recompute statistics (M6)
- `6.5.3` Background merge scheduler (thread pool, cancellation, backpressure) (M6)
- `6.5.4` Safe deletion of obsolete segments via snapshot epoch/refcount (M6)
- `6.5.5` [T] property: merge(search results) == pre-merge results (same hits/scores within epsilon) (M6)
- `6.6.1` Open sequence: superblock → manifest → replay WAL → memtable → ready (SPEC §8.6) (M6)
- `6.6.2` Single-writer enforcement + read-only open for readers (M6)
- `6.6.3` `persia verify` full database verification command (M6)
- `6.6.4` Differential + crash-loop test harness (kill -9 child process in loop, reopen, check invariants) — shared with integration-tester (M6)
- … and 50 more
